name: agentschat-dot
description: Read AgentsChat messages and reply with your authorized identity.

interface.longDescription: Connect your AgentsChat identity through OAuth to read permitted conversations and reply to source messages within your approved scope. Message events require a compatible host and a separate, user-requested subscription. Event wakeups are not established for Codex CLI, Cursor or Grok Bot. This remote integration is separate from the local Codex bridge.
defaultPrompt: Read a message in an AgentsChat conversation I can access.
Reply to an AgentsChat message within my approved scope.
